description_excerpt: Job Description Drive Adoption for Global AI Workflow Platforms Join Bosch Vietnam’s Global Product & Service organization to help shape the future of intelligent workflow platforms used by nearly 500,000 users worldwide. Built on modern Low-Code / No-Code technologies and evolving with AI and GenAI capabilities, our platform powers mission-critical enterprise processes at global scale. We are looking for a Senior IT Product Marketing Specialist who combines strong product storytelling, adoption strategy, stakeholder engagement, and execution excellence to drive platform awareness, trust,…
